name: Mary
overview: Scripture presents Mary primarily as the virgin mother of Jesus, fulfilling the prophecy in Isaiah 7:14, and as the wife of Joseph, through whom Jesus was born (Matthew 1:16). She is depicted as a devoted mother concerned for her son, seeking to speak with Him during His ministry (Matthew 12:46-47). Additionally, Mary Magdalene is recognized as a faithful follower present at the crucifixion and intimately involved in Jesus’ life and death (Matthew 27:56), highlighting the distinct roles of women named Mary in the Gospel narrative.
